candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is consistent and clean across all views, with clear hardware and dark trim details visible in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing edge corrosion and rust runs, but the broad paint surfaces appear too clean and lack the fine soft settled dust required on upward faces.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a uniform, high-quality finish with sharp edges and clear material roles for the painted steel and hardware.

locker_aged.explanation: The reference aged state demonstrates a more organic distribution of rust and wear, particularly on the vertical faces and corners, though it also lacks visible dust.

grey-green_painted_steel.observations: The base color is a consistent grey-green across both candidate and reference in the as-built state.

bare_hardware.observations: Handles and latches are rendered as distinct bare metal elements, contrasting with the painted body.

dark_trim.observations: Dark trim is visible along the bottom edges and around the ventilation slits in the as-built views.

edge_corrosion.observations: Both candidate and reference show significant rust and paint loss along the vertical edges and corners in the aged state.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow downward rust streaks are visible on the vertical faces of the aged candidate, particularly in the front and detail views.

settled_dust.observations: Upward-facing surfaces in the aged state appear too clean and lack the fine, soft dust layer specified in the brief.

faded_fabric.observations: No fabric pads are visible on the media cabinet geometry in any of the provided views.

findings: Add a fine, soft dust layer to all upward-facing surfaces in the aged state to match the 1000-year sealed environment brief.
Increase the variation in the aged paint texture on broad faces to better match the organic wear of the reference locker.
Ensure the rust runs on vertical faces are more subtle and irregular to avoid a repetitive or painted-on look.
limitations: The top view of the aged state is small and lacks detail, making it difficult to fully assess the dust and wear on the top surface.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected
